# Sunbright Recovery Center

> Sunbright Recovery Center is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit preparing to open a 16-bed, co-ed residential addiction recovery center at 22425 Sunbright Ave, Red Bluff, California 96080, serving Northern California. The building is complete; the state license has been approved and is being finalized, and no opening date has been announced. This site is the center's community and fundraising site.

Key facts:
- Status: preparing to open. State license approved and being finalized.
- Nonprofit: IRS 501(c)(3) public charity, EIN 42-2737546, effective May 23, 2026. Donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.
- Founder: Linda Spyres, LCSW, LAADC-CA. Program Manager: Faith O'Dell, SUDRC.
- Phone: (530) 513-4294. Email: info@sunbrightrecovery.org.
- Address: 22425 Sunbright Ave, Red Bluff, CA 96080.
- Parish Health and Wellness is a founding community partner.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.sunbrightrecovery.org/): what Sunbright is building, planned programs, how to donate, and common questions
- [About](https://www.sunbrightrecovery.org/about/): founder, program leadership, mission and nonprofit status
- [Get Involved](https://www.sunbrightrecovery.org/get-involved/): ways to donate, adopt a room or bed, give items, or volunteer
- [Events](https://www.sunbrightrecovery.org/events/): fundraisers and community events
- [Contact](https://www.sunbrightrecovery.org/contact/): phone, email, address and contact form
